t: This is the Boer War memorial in Islington, a statue with a cannon standing on each side. The sculptor was Bertram Mackennal, an Australian who found international success and received a good deal of royal patronage in Britain. He worked in the classical tradition, and is best known for stylised allegorical nudes and themes from classical mythology. In 1909 he became the first Australian elected an Associate of the Royal Academy, and in 1921 the first Australian artist to be knighted. He made this memorial.
